summary: #1317 probe: one MiniMax-H3-Image edit at 2048x2048 from three references (two cast portraits, one scene still).
description: Stage A of #1317 (#1345): the identity arm of the MiniMax-H3-Image probe. 'images' holds three references the prompt names as <Picture 1>..<Picture 3> in order: cast/estela.jpg and cast/aurelio.jpg (Don's cast portraits) and parhelion/kf-open.png (a scene still). The same refs and intent go through Klein in klein-edit3.json, so the two stills are an A/B; score identity with bench/workflows/t26-face-check.json against each portrait. References are resized by the pipeline only when their short edge is outside 1024..2048. Recipe: MiniMax-H3-Image through its diffusers modular pipeline (MiniMaxH3ImageModularPipeline), transformer and text encoder SDNQ-quantized at 'weights_dtype' with H3's quantizer arguments, the transformer block-level group offloaded, the text encoder's lm_head removed and its language model truncated to 51 layers (the pipeline reads hidden_states[50]) under leaf-level offload, and the VAE on demand in bf16 (it is H3-Image's own AutoencoderKLMiniMaxH3Image, not H3's video VAE, so H3's int8 VAE recipe is not carried over). modules_to_not_convert is read off the H3-Image transformer (proj_in, context_embedder, time_embedder, time_proj, token_refiner, norm_out, pdd_proj_out), not copied from H3 video. The text encoder is loaded from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 at the commit the H3 templates pin (0919fb68), so it shares H3's quantized cache and the run fetches only H3-Image's transformer_diffusers and vae_diffusers (~68.6 GB), not the repo's ~204 GB. The sampler is fixed by the checkpoint (6 steps, guidance distilled): no num_inference_steps, guidance_scale or negative_prompt. Width and height are multiples of 32; min_generation_area (pipeline default 4194304, i.e. 2048x2048) upscales a smaller canvas to that area - pass 1024 to generate at the size asked for (the #1317 1024x1024 run).

variables.prompt: The woman from <Picture 1> and the man from <Picture 2> sit across from each other at a small table in the setting shown in <Picture 3>, leaning in as if mid-conversation. Keep each face, hairstyle and build exactly as in their portraits; keep the frozen-lake setting, its dusk light and its colour grade exactly as in <Picture 3>. Photographic, natural skin texture, medium two-shot at eye level, both faces clearly visible.

width.reason: MiniMax-H3-Image's canvas is a multiple of 32 (VAE compression 16 x patch 2); refused here rather than after the weights load
